title: Scientists discover a hydraulic link between the abdomen and the brain
desc: A new study suggests that flexing your abdominal muscles physically moves your brain. This gentle shifting acts as a hydraulic pump, forcing fluids through brain tissue to wash away harmful waste and promote cognitive health.

title: Dagrin’s Mum Speaks About Life Without Rapper, Royalty 16 Years After: “Many Took Advantage of Us”
desc: Rapper Dagrin's mother has opened up about her experience after his tragic demise 16 years after he passed away. She also spoke about his royalty.

title: Major roads to close in Nairobi ahead of Africa Forward Summit
desc: City Hall, Harambee Avenue, and Parliament Rd to be closed on May 11 and 12 for Africa Forward Summit; traffic disruptions expected in Nairobi, police boss Mohamud says

desc: Google added more link surfaces to AI Search, but not new reporting for publishers. Studies continue to show lower clicks when AI responses appear.

title: Paediatric AKI Linked to Long-Term Kidney Risks
desc: A new meta-analysis links pediatric AKI with higher long-term CKD and mortality risk. Find out why experts call for structured follow-up care.

title: Meet China’s moon porter for Chang’e-8 mission: a 4-wheeled robot with 2 arms
desc: The AI-powered ‘extraordinary’ rover is set to pick up and install gear developed by teams from around the world on the lunar south pole.

title: Head impacts are associated with altered gut microbiome in football players
desc: Non-concussive head impacts—hits to the head that don't cause clinically detectable symptoms—are correlated with subsequent changes to the gut microbiome in a small sample of US collegiate football players, according to a study published in PLOS One by Ahmet Ay and Kenneth Douglas Belanger of Colgate University, U.S., and colleagues.
